full_judgment: 10. In criminal jurisprudence, the burden of proof lies upon the prosecution to prove the guilt of the accuseds and the accuseds have no burden to prove their innocence. Let us now examine the evidence to decide how far the prosecution have been able to prove the charge brought against the convicts.
